aboutMe:

𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘
25% average annual return since 2013.
If you copied then for $1,000, you would have over $18,000 today.
 
𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗬

Full-time professional investor.

Former Strategy Consultant, advising some of the world’s largest banks and tech companies. 

M.Sc. in Finance & Strategic Management from Copenhagen Business School.

Over 25 professional certifications in finance.
